meta.power_validation_status: Independent beta; historical input-timing limitations prevent validated or established labeling.
meta.power_method: Fitted neutral-field margin rating using current-season result Elo, talent and returning-production priors with weekly decay, plus opponent-adjusted on-field performance.
meta.schedule_strength_usage: Displayed for context only; the predictive engine already opponent-adjusts performance, so SOS is not added a second time.
meta.resume_method: Opponent quality from THI Power, result, capped margin and location. FCS wins receive limited credit; FCS losses receive a major penalty.
meta.methodology: THI Power is the poll-free fitted neutral-field margin rating. Current Form shows opponent-adjusted in-season efficiency, Game Control shows capped location-adjusted SRS, and THI Resume separately ranks accomplishment. Internal SOS is displayed but not added again because the Power, Current Form and Game Control engines already adjust for opponent quality.
